sectors.name: FIRST CONTACT
sectors.tip: Break their formation. Keep moving between shots.

sectors.name: SERPENT BELT
sectors.tip: Divers loop through your flight lane. Watch below.

sectors.name: IRON CONVOY
sectors.tip: Tanks take four hits. Focus your fire.

sectors.name: CROSSFIRE
sectors.tip: Spitters fire fans. Slip between them.

sectors.name: THE HIVE
sectors.tip: Clear the guard. Destroy the exposed core.

sectors.name: NEEDLE RUN
sectors.tip: Diving wings attack through the center.

sectors.name: PRISM GATE
sectors.tip: Break the ring, then face its guardian.

sectors.name: GHOST CORRIDOR
sectors.tip: Delayed ambushes close the safe lanes.

sectors.name: BROODSTORM
sectors.tip: Clear the swarm before the next group arrives.

sectors.name: LAST SIGNAL
sectors.tip: One final gauntlet. Finish the Matriarch.
